title: What DNA Foundation Models Learn Beyond Sequence Composition
abstract: arXiv:2610.15711v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Do genomic foundation models (FMs) provide predictive information beyond simple sequence composition? We evaluate frozen representations from five DNA FMs against normalized k-mer frequencies across 57 genomic classification datasets and two exploratory gene-expression regression tasks. Simple k-mer features remain competitive with most models, whereas NTv3 shows a consistent advantage; the ranking is robust to globally fixed and multi-scale k-mer baselines and alternative downstream probes. To test incremental predictive utility directly, we compare global 6-mer features with their concatenation with each FM embedding under a matched Random Forest protocol. NTv3 improves 46 of 57 datasets (mean $\Delta$MCC = +0.072), while Caduceus provides smaller gains and the other models do not improve mean MCC. translated_abstract: 基因组基础模型（FM）是否提供了超越简单序列组成的预测信息？我们在57个基因组分类数据集和两个探索性的基因表达回归任务上，将五个DNA基础模型的冻结表示与归一化的k-mer频率进行了对比评估。简单的k-mer特征与大多数模型相比仍具有竞争力，而NTv3则表现出一致的优势；这一排名在全局固定的和多尺度的k-mer基线以及替代的下游探测方法下均保持稳健。为了直接检验增量预测效用，我们在匹配的随机森林协议下，比较了全局6-mer特征与将其与每个FM嵌入拼接后的特征。NTv3在57个数据集中的46个上有所提升（平均ΔMCC = +0.072），而Caduceus提供的增益较小，其他模型则未能提高平均MCC。我们进一步将嵌入分解为可从6-mer频率线性预测的分量和岭回归残差，发现线性
tldr: 该研究通过在57个基因组分类数据集上将五个DNA基础模型的冻结表示与简单的k-mer频率特征进行系统对比，发现大多数模型的预测能力并未超越序列组成信息，唯有NTv3表现出一致且显著的增量预测优势。
en_tdlr: By benchmarking frozen representations of five DNA foundation models against simple k-mer frequency features across 57 genomic classification datasets, this study finds that most models provide little predictive information beyond sequence composition, with NTv3 being the only model showing consistent incremental gains.
